plugins.description: Open .vc and .vc.json files as value chain diagrams: model process steps, org units and their connections, and see an agent's changes to the file as they happen.

releases.name: Value Chain Modeler
releases.changelog:
### Features

* **value-chain:** open value chain diagrams in Orca ([#545](https://github.com/Miragon/modeler-suite/issues/545)) ([39598d1](https://github.com/Miragon/modeler-suite/commit/39598d10ff8af6842d0730e585786094f23cc421)), closes [#537](https://github.com/Miragon/modeler-suite/issues/537)


### Dependencies

* The following workspace dependencies were updated
  * dependencies
    * @miragon/modeler-shell bumped from 0.10.0 to 0.11.0
    * value-chain-ide-editor bumped from 0.0.0 to 0.1.0

plugins.description: Open .wmap and .owm files as Wardley maps: place components on the evolution axis, draw their dependencies, and see an agent's changes to the file as they happen.

releases.name: Wardley Maps Modeler
releases.changelog:
### Features

* **wardley-maps:** open Wardley maps in Orca ([#548](https://github.com/Miragon/modeler-suite/issues/548)) ([646ef3d](https://github.com/Miragon/modeler-suite/commit/646ef3d4c22f00f7b9337fc2ba5d5de77052f8ad)), closes [#537](https://github.com/Miragon/modeler-suite/issues/537)


### Dependencies

* The following workspace dependencies were updated
  * dependencies
    * @miragon/modeler-shell bumped from 0.10.0 to 0.11.0
    * @miragon/wardley-renderer bumped from 0.16.0 to 0.16.1
    * wardley-maps-ide-editor bumped from 0.0.0 to 0.1.0
